title: Section formula for a fixed augmented lift
statement: For f:X→S, g:S′→S with g and g′ flat, F an O_X-module, injective resolutions I of F and J of g′^*F, an augmented lift t of η_F, and p≥0, the adjoint of flatBaseChangeResolutionBeta f g I J t p sends D.sourceClass p ξ to D.targetClass p of moduleCohomologyFMap h D.psi p ξ for every open V, every D:FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V and every ξ∈H^p(f⁻¹V,F). Here h=g′ restricted to g′⁻¹(f⁻¹V), and sourceClass, targetClass and Beta are the fixed constructions of [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-construction]; D is as in [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices] and moduleCohomologyFMap is [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap].

proof.text: The formula [lem-weil-pbc-flat-pullback-homology-sections] computes the section action of beta through the explicitly constructed open map. The augmented-lift comparison [lem-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-restricted-lift-homology] identifies this open map with moduleCohomologyFMap for D.psi. Apply D.targetClass to that map equality, evaluate at xi, and compose the equalities.

lean.statement:
theorem flatBaseChangeResolutionBeta_sections {X S S' : Scheme.{uBC}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    [Flat g] [Flat (pullback.snd g f)] {F : X.Modules}
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (t : I.cocomplex ⟶ ((pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (ht : I.ι.f 0 ≫ t.f 0 =
      (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd g f))).unit.app F ≫
        (pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).map (J.ι.f 0))
    (p : ℕ) :
    ∀ (V : S.Opens)
        (D : FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V)
        (xi : (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{uBC}).obj
          ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
            ((restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F))),
        Hom.app ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).homEquiv _ _
          (flatBaseChangeResolutionBeta f g I J t p)) V
          (D.sourceClass p xi) =
        D.targetClass p
          (moduleCohomologyFMap ((pullback.snd g f).resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
            ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl) D.psi p xi)
